transcript: I am a final year software engineering student and I like UI UX design work. I know some Figma via frames and usability testing. I did a customer support chat box for customer service. It was not a big project but I learned things from it. My project part was about intent, flow design and response testing. There were many problems, main read, wrong responses for similar questions. We fixed it after trying many times. I want this job because I like ITN. I think I can do work. Sometimes I get nervous and I forget some points. This project was helped me understand teamwork and basic user experience.
feedback: You have a good foundation in UI UX design and experience with Figma, which is great for this role. However, during the interview, you seemed a bit nervous and struggled to clearly articulate your thoughts and experiences. It would be beneficial to practice speaking confidently and concisely about your projects and skills to effectively communicate your value to potential employers.
strengths: Relevant experience with UI UX design tools like Figma
Hands-on experience with a customer support chat box project
weaknesses: Difficulty in clearly explaining project details and experiences
suggestions: Prepare and practice answering common interview questions related to your role and projects
Focus on speaking clearly and at a moderate pace to convey confidence
Use specific examples from your projects to demonstrate your skills and experiences
Emphasize what you learned from your projects and how they can be applied to the job role
better_answer_example: As a final year software engineering student, I've developed a strong interest in UI UX design, particularly with tools like Figma. In my recent project, I designed a customer support chat box, focusing on intent, flow design, and response testing. Although it was a small project, I learned a lot about teamwork and user experience. I'm excited about this role at ITN because I believe my skills and experience align well with the company's goals. I'm confident that I can contribute to the team and continue to grow as a professional in the field.
